titleEn: COD confirmation template with Confirm/Refuse buttons

en: How does the customer confirm a COD order?

steps: Store creates COD order; Chat sends template with Confirm/Refuse; result sent to the Store; no answer in 24h = no_reply
edgeCases: Template must be approved and number connected
No active package: sends, agent and number connect answer 403 plan_required (no free plan, WA-NOFREE-1); a past_due package keeps replies/confirmations up to 7 days
